environment.description: Same EC2 instance and application code deployed in an isolated VPC (10.200.0.0/16) with no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no VPC peering connections. The service is exposed exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). Consumer access requires the endpoint service to accept the connection request (manual acceptance enabled). The VPC has no route table entries pointing to 0.0.0.0/0 — all routes are local (10.200.0.0/16) and the pl-prefix list for the S3 gateway endpoint. DNS resolution for the endpoint resolves only within consumer VPCs that have provisioned the interface endpoint. The EC2 instance security group allows inbound TCP 8080 only from the ENI of the VPC endpoint (sg-vpce-0abc123). There is no ALB, no public IP, no Elastic IP associated with the instance or any ENI in the VPC.

config.vpc: 10.200.0.0/16, no IGW, no NAT-GW, no peering, no Transit Gateway attachment
config.route_table: local route only (10.200.0.0/16), pl-63a5400a for S3 gateway
config.privatelink: vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890, manual acceptance required, allowed_principals restricted to ou-abc123
config.instance: no public IP, no EIP, private subnet only
config.dns: no public DNS, endpoint DNS private zone only
config.network_acl: deny all inbound from 0.0.0.0/0, allow only 10.200.0.0/16
